title: Recover missing Codex retry slot ownership and handoffs
body:
## Summary
- reconstruct missing logical implementation owners from joined retry authority and accepted Codex receipts without fresh execution admission
- classify exact retired ownership before pointer promotion and preserve historical/incompatible ownership outcomes
- account restored work in slot capacity and document the durable recovery and observability boundaries
- add regression coverage for missing-owner replay and over-limit capacity accounting

## Testing
- `bash scripts/test.sh tests/test_codex_retry_promotion.py`
- `bash scripts/test.sh -m "not browser and not opencode_live"`

Closes #2252
